category: geocoding, places and map tiles API

free_tier.stated: Free plan, USD 0 a month, no credit card: 3,000 forward geocodes a day, 300 reverse geocodes a day and 100 places searches a day by the terms table; the API docs describe one unified pool of 3,000 total API calls a day shared by geocoding, reverse, places and tile requests
free_tier.notes: the terms table and the docs page describe the daily quota differently, and which one applies is unverified; calls without any key are also answered in small numbers (the Python SDK page says 30 geocodes a day, and a keyless call returned an x-ratelimit-limit header of 60); the Pro plan is USD 29 a month for 1,000,000 geocoding requests a month

per_object_cap.stated: no batch endpoint: one address a request, and the batch geocoding page sends 10 to 50 parallel single requests; Free dataset uploads are 3 datasets of at most 50 MB each

retention.stated: no rule for storing results is stated

egress.terms: not applicable: a query API metered in requests, not bytes

interface_detail: HTTPS GET to api.latlng.work/api (forward) and /reverse with the key in an X-Api-Key header or an api_key parameter, GeoJSON answers; places, static map and autosuggest endpoints and vector tiles at tiles.latlng.work use the same account; a call without any key answered HTTP 200 with GeoJSON and an x-ratelimit-limit header of 60
tooling: any HTTP client; an official Rust crate and a Python SDK
chaining: 3,000 forward geocodes a day on an email or GitHub account with no card, built on OpenStreetMap data, plus 300 reverse geocodes a day and vector tiles on the same key; public applications must show the OpenStreetMap attribution; bulk work is parallel single requests since no batch endpoint exists

limits.value: 3,000 forward geocodes, 300 reverse geocodes and 100 places searches a day on the Free plan (terms table); the docs list one pool of 3,000 total API calls a day
no per-second limit is published; the API answers HTTP 429 when the quota is exceeded and sends X-RateLimit-Limit and X-RateLimit-Remaining headers
3 datasets of at most 50 MB each on the Free plan

binding_note: no per-second figure is published, so the daily quota is the ceiling that is stated and met first

identity_cost.detail: an account at dash.latlng.work, a JavaScript sign-in page whose fields are not in the page text; the vendor's page says to sign up with an email or GitHub and get instant API keys with no credit card; one account and one API key per entity on the free tier; the form fields themselves are unverified: behind a sign-up

reliability_note: exceeding the plan limits may suspend access to the affected service, and extra free accounts opened to get more quota can end every account; the allowance without a key is small
confidence_note: the home page, the docs, the terms, the batch geocoding page, the Python SDK page and the key-free sign-up page were quoted on 2026-11-02; a call without a key answered HTTP 200 with GeoJSON. No account was opened, so the free daily quota and the sign-up fields were not exercised.
